deviations.what: Frame condition named itFC (local def, ∀ w, r w w) instead of Mathlib's Reflexive
deviations.why: Reflexive is @[deprecated] in the pinned Mathlib version (superseded by Std.Refl, a typeclass whose shape does not match IValidFC's bare-predicate FC parameter); using the deprecated name would emit a build warning at every use site, violating the zero-warnings gate. itFC mirrors the classical Systems/T/Completeness.lean file's own local tFC convention -- same semantic content, no design change.
